name: Aram
bio: Aram, a son of Shem, is listed among the nations descended from Noah after the flood, and was himself the father of Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash; he is the ancestor of the Aramean people named throughout the Old Testament, and a different figure from the later Aram son of Kemuel, Nahor's grandson (Genesis 10:22-23; 22:20-21).
